dex.entry: A quick frost-moth with wings patterned in delicate ice-crystal mandalas that catch moonlight and scatter it as prismatic cold sparks. It flits between the telescope domes leaving frosty petal-impressions on the glass. A moth made of moonlit frost — beautiful, fleeting, and endlessly collectible.
